fault_classifier.note: learned from injected signature patterns only; no real labelled faults yet

fault_types.name: vibration_too_high
fault_types.text: overall vibration well above this machine's normal

fault_types.name: unbalance_like
fault_types.text: once-per-turn vibration grown (unbalance, a bent shaft, a lost blade)

fault_types.name: misalignment_like
fault_types.text: twice-per-turn vibration grown (misalignment, a worn coupling)

fault_types.name: looseness_or_rattle
fault_types.text: many harmonics, half-order and rattling (looseness, a soft foot, a cracked mount)

fault_types.name: repeating_knock
fault_types.text: a knock or click that repeats (damaged belt splice, gear tooth, clicking drive)

fault_types.name: impacts
fault_types.text: jolts or bangs much more often than usual (collisions, a jam, loose parts hitting)

fault_types.name: bearing_defect_like
fault_types.text: pulses at bearing defect rates in vibration or high-pitched sound (rolling-bearing wear)

fault_types.name: speed_change
fault_types.text: running speed away from its usual (belt slip, a failing drive, a different load)

fault_types.name: electrical_motor
fault_types.text: twice-mains vibration and hum grown (motor electrical fault, a failing supply)

fault_types.name: new_tone_whine_squeal
fault_types.text: a new or louder tone (whine, squeal, a belt or bearing singing)

fault_types.name: grinding_or_hiss
fault_types.text: rough high-pitched noise (grinding, lubrication loss, cavitation, arcing)

fault_types.name: alarm_or_beeping
fault_types.text: a tone switching on and off (an alarm, a warning beeper, a UPS on battery)

fault_types.name: overheating
fault_types.text: hotter than usual for this machine

fault_types.name: heating_up_over_time
fault_types.text: temperature climbing over hours, days or weeks

fault_types.name: local_hot_spot
fault_types.text: one small part heating (a connection, a bearing, a cable, a contact)

fault_types.name: area_running_cold
fault_types.text: an area cooler than usual (a stopped fan, blocked fins or flow, a failed heater)

fault_types.name: excess_temperature_fluctuation
fault_types.text: temperature swinging more than usual (cycling, hunting, an intermittent fault)

fault_types.name: unsteady_vibration_or_sound
fault_types.text: vibration or sound coming and going more than usual (intermittent fault)

fault_types.name: room_too_hot_or_humid
fault_types.text: the room warmer or damper than usual (cooling failure, condensation risk)

fault_types.name: device_moved
fault_types.text: the device has been moved or knocked (its tilt changed)

fault_types.name: camera_moved_or_blocked
fault_types.text: the thermal image no longer looks like its usual view

feature_table.name: vib_peak2
feature_table.text: level of the second strongest vibration peak

feature_table.name: vib_env_peak_hz
feature_table.text: envelope of 100-450 Hz vibration: strongest repeating rate (bearings, gears)

feature_table.name: vib_env_peak
feature_table.text: how far that envelope rate stands above the rest

feature_table.name: vib_env_order
feature_table.text: that envelope rate as a multiple of running speed (0 if no speed)

feature_table.name: vib_velocity_mm_s
feature_table.text: vibration velocity, 10-250 Hz rms (ISO 10816-like, partial band)

feature_table.name: vib_line_2x
feature_table.text: vibration at 100/120 Hz (twice mains: electrical, magnetic)

feature_table.name: imu_temp_c
feature_table.text: temperature from the IMU's own sensor: on a machine it follows the surface the IMU is fixed to, with a lag (a heat reading when there is no thermal camera)

feature_table.name: slow_peak1_hz
feature_table.text: strongest slow vibration peak, 0.4-20 Hz (pulleys, idlers)

feature_table.name: slow_peak1
feature_table.text: level of the strongest slow vibration peak

feature_table.name: slow_peak2
feature_table.text: level of the second strongest slow vibration peak

feature_table.name: knock_period_s
feature_table.text: time between repeating knocks or clicks over the last 5 min

feature_table.name: knock_repeat
feature_table.text: how regularly the knocks repeat (0 none, 1 perfectly)

feature_table.name: trend_shocks_10m
feature_table.text: sudden jolts in the last 10 minutes

feature_table.name: trend_since_shock_s
feature_table.text: seconds since the last sudden jolt

feature_table.name: trend_heat_1m
feature_table.text: hottest point above room, average over 1m

feature_table.name: trend_heat_10m
feature_table.text: hottest point above room, average over 10m

feature_table.name: trend_heat_1h
feature_table.text: hottest point above room, average over 1h

feature_table.name: trend_heat_6h
feature_table.text: hottest point above room, average over 6h

feature_table.name: trend_heat_rise_per_min
feature_table.text: hottest point above room: rise per minute over the last 2 minutes

feature_table.name: trend_heat_rise_per_h
feature_table.text: hottest point above room: rise per hour over the last hour

feature_table.name: trend_heat_swing_10m
feature_table.text: how much the hottest point above room swings over 10 min, second to second (10th to 90th percentile range)

feature_table.name: trend_heat_swing_1h
feature_table.text: how much the hottest point above room swings over 1 h, minute to minute (10th to 90th percentile range)

feature_table.name: trend_vib_swing_10m
feature_table.text: how much the vibration level swings over 10 min, second to second (10th to 90th percentile range)

feature_table.name: trend_vib_swing_1h
feature_table.text: how much the vibration level swings over 1 h, minute to minute (10th to 90th percentile range)
